domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or more fractions are converted to equivalent fractions so the denominators match before subtraction.
Tag for unlike-denominator pure fractions and mixed-number items whose fractional parts must be aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators are already aligned.
Do not tag normalization of a whole number or improper mixed number unless the step also performs denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to enable part-by-part subtraction of whole and fractional parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the subtraction step may produce a zero or negative fractional part before any regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands into compatible form.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps that adjust an insufficient fractional part.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-assembly-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve an insufficient or negative fractional part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole-number part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative or impossible in the current form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as having a 0-fraction part.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction when no regrouping occurs.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms or convert a zero fractional part into an integer or whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by common factors.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that merely produces the unsimplified result.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly performed in that step.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer representation when that assembly is shown as a distinct step.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one final answer.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as just a fraction.
Tag when a mixed-number computation concludes by writing the final mixed number or integer after part-by-part work.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure-fraction items that end directly with a subtraction result unless a separate assembly step is shown.
Do not tag simplification-only steps that reduce a fraction but do not assemble parts.
Do not tag operand rewrites done before subtraction.
